text.card: TOI-1760 is a star of 3,212 K, bound to TOI-1452 97 AU away.
text.introduction: TOI-1760 shares its motion through space with TOI-1452, 97 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: TOI-1760's orbit around TOI-1452 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are
